title: CPH2513_14.0.0.1600(EX01)
description:
New Version: CPH2513_14.0.0.1600(EX01)

A new software update is available for your Android Smartphone.

This release includes the following:

• Android security patch updated to 2025-01-01.

If you choose not to do so now, the update will take place AUTOMATICALLY between 2AM and 6AM starting on January 17, 2025. Data rates may apply. Please do not turn off your device while the update is installing. During Installation you cannot use your device at all, even to dial 9-1-1.
